item.stem:
The diagram shows a colour scale from $-100$ to $+100$ for the difference between per capita rice and wheat use. Region R is marked with value $+40$. Krish reads the infographic.

Which claim is correct?

options.A: Region R has per capita rice and wheat use of 40 in total.
options.B: Region R prefers wheat more strongly than rice.
options.C: Region R shows a stronger rice preference than wheat by the encoded difference 40.
options.D: Any coloured region can be ranked by shade alone before reading the scale.
